metadata.coordinate_system: Selenographic latitude and longitude in degrees

priority_scale.meaning: 1 is always eligible for display; 20 is shown only at the closest zoom levels
priority_scale.note: Priority is a label-density/zoom-culling rank, not scientific importance.

metadata.image_note: image.filename is relative to the Images directory. Keep the Images folder beside this JSON. Failed downloads are marked with download_error.
